title: Cookbook: find today's recipe and plan the week

steps.say: This is the cookbook, live on Cloudflare Pages. It has one recipe for every day of the year, and a meal plan for every week.
Browse Recipes opens today's recipe, with its prep and cook times and how many it serves.
Below that are the ingredients and the numbered instructions.
At the bottom, Next day steps through the year one recipe at a time.
Plans opens this week's meal plan. The shopping list adds up every ingredient for the week's seven recipes, so you can shop in one trip.
Staples you probably have already are listed apart, and the week's recipes follow, one for each day.
